content: BERT's bi-directional context poses a problem for us to calculate an auto-regressive joint probability. A simple fix could be that we mask all the tokens $\mathbf {x}_{>i}$ and we calculate the conditional factors as we do for an unidirectional model. By doing so though, we loose upon the advantage of bi-directional context the BERT model enables. We propose an approximation of the joint probability as,
